title: Bitcoin Spot ETFs Record Third-Largest Weekly Outflow – Is Short-Term Correction Ahead?
summary: Bitcoin ETFs recorded their third-largest net outflows of $1.22 billion last week, with $558.4 million in net outflows on Friday alone. The post Bitcoin Spot ETFs Record Third-Largest Weekly Outflow – Is Short-Term Correction Ahead? appeared first on Cryptonews .
